name: Qallupilluk
description: Qallupilluk is a water-dwelling humanoid being from Inuit folklore that lurks beneath Arctic sea ice to abduct children who wander too close to the water's edge, functioning as a cautionary tradition protecting children from the real dangers of Arctic ice.
origin: The Qallupilluk tradition is documented in Inuit communities across Arctic Canada (especially Nunavut) and Alaska.
